scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && vitest run

//typescript: Held on 6.0.x, as finance-stack holds it (finance-stack/app/package.json).
Floor: the @types packages declare a minimum compiler of 5.6, which 6.0 clears.
eslint-config-next) declares a peer of `>=4.8.4 <6.1.0`. TypeScript 7 is the
native port and doesn't expose the compiler API `next build` drives, so
.github/dependabot.yml ignores the major. Re-derive both ends when a type
package moves or typescript-eslint widens its peer range.
//eslint: Held on 9.x, as finance-stack holds it. The caret is load-bearing: ESLint 10
removed the rule-context accessors that the plugins eslint-config-next 16.4.6
vendors still call (eslint-plugin-react 7.37.5 peers at ^9.7), so 10.x crashes
at rule-load time. Lift once eslint-config-next ships ESLint 10-compatible
plugins; .github/dependabot.yml ignores the major until then.
